I also had to buy an adapter to run 3 monitors. From my experience, make sure you buy an ACTIVE adapter as a passive adapter will not work! Also don't cheap out on it, or you'll have a bad user experience down the line. The one I used would have problems with coming back from sleep mode or being powered off, as it would not detect the third monitor until I disconnected and reconnected the adapter (disconnecting and reconnecting the cable from/to the adapter or monitor would not fix it).
